title: search's returned count and its note disagree with the rows the answer carries
body:
`intent search Retention --tier structural --limit 20 --json` answers `matched: 17, returned: 17` and carries 2 hits (backup.rs:89 def, backup.rs:111 ref). At `--limit 8` the prose form prints `note: 8 of 17 shown` and two rows. So `returned` and the note count rows the answer does not carry, fifteen of seventeen here. The contract on `--limit` is that the answer reports both what matched and what came back; here what came back is neither number. Whatever drops the rows after counting (a filter applied after the count, or a de-duplication in rendering) has to run before `returned` is computed, and the count has to be the length of the body.

CLOSED 2026-09-14 (dc): the code-search loop in `search_all` ran whatever `--tier` said, so `--tier structural` counted the lexical code rows and then dropped their group. It now runs only when the lexical tier is asked, and `matched` and `returned` are summed from the groups the answer carries, with `--limit` applied per group, so `returned` is the length of the body. Before: `matched 23, returned 22`, 2 rows. After: `matched 2, returned 2`, 2 rows.
